title: Plague Doctor
name: Paracelsus
description: The Plague Doctor is a physician of radical theories, expelled from her university and still bitter towards the scholars who mocked her. An expert in disease, she distils her own toxins and remedies, and having seen in her professor what lies past death, will use either to keep her companions on this side of it. The sickness interests her at least as much as the sick, and here she can study it freely, on patients no one else will touch.
history: The Plague Doctor was a brilliant student of medicine whose unconventional theories caused a scandal at her university. The mockery of her peers and professors only drove her deeper into her own experiments. One evening she found her hated professor slumped dead at his podium, and took his body for her experiments. She revived him, but could not stabilise what she had brought back, and had to kill him herself to end his screaming. She was expelled soon after.
summary: A brilliant physician whose unconventional theories led her to reanimate her professor, and got her expelled.

clothing.head: Dark hood over a beaked plague mask with round lenses
clothing.body: Long dark coat with studded skirts and spiked leather pauldrons
clothing.legs: Dark breeches and buckled leather boots
clothing.accessories: Round spectacles (hidden by mask), satchel strap, belt with vial holsters

notes: Speaks in medical vocabulary that mixes humoral theory with modern technique
Notices the medical use or significance of an object or situation before anything else
Has almost no tolerance for alcohol; a single drink leaves her tipsy
Is fond of leeches, identifies them by species, and talks about them eagerly when given the chance
Never shows her trauma, and keeps it veiled beneath pride in her accomplishments
